description: The plot illustrates how BPC changes over training for two series (a black training curve and a magenta validation curve) as training progresses. The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps” with a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 50 with major ticks at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50, and it includes a “(×10³)” multiplier indicating steps are in thousands. The y-axis is labeled “BPC” on a linear scale, ranging approximately from 1.1 up to 2.2 with labeled ticks at 1.2, 1.4, 1.6, 1.8, 2.0, and 2.2. The black line uses x-shaped markers and a solid stroke; it starts near about 2.15 at 0k steps, drops steeply to around 1.45 by roughly 3k, continues decreasing more gradually to about 1.20 by ~19–20k, then shows a small step down to roughly 1.16 at ~20k and remains nearly flat with slight downward drift to about 1.13 by ~50k. The magenta line uses circular markers and a solid stroke (labeled “SimSMoE Validating”); it begins near about 2.15 at 0k, falls to around 1.45 by ~3k, declines to about 1.19 by ~19–20k, then steps down to roughly 1.15 at ~20k and stays close to flat with a slight decrease to about 1.11–1.12 by ~50k.
